title: Analysis code for functional transitions under persistent metabolic burden in CHARLS, HRS, and ELSA
description: Versioned statistical analysis code for coordinated CHARLS, HRS, and ELSA analyses of depressive symptoms, memory, and transitions into and out of ADL disability under persistent metabolic burden. Version 2.2.0 adds first-wave health-covariate timing, a principal continuous two-wave symptom-burden model, restricted cubic splines, staged attenuation analyses, and corresponding figure code. No participant-level data, derived data, numerical results, figures, or manuscript files are included.
